name: Customer ID Agent
fn: Identifies the paying customer via MICR, email domain, invoice refs and historical patterns
detail: Resolves the paying customer when a remittance is ambiguous by scoring MICR/bank data, email domains, invoice-reference patterns and historical behaviour against the SAP customer master. Turns "unidentified payer" exceptions into clean, postable cash.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
